title: Never Hike in the Snow: A Friday the 13th Fan Film
original_title: Never Hike in the Snow: A Friday the 13th Fan Film
overview: Set three months prior to "Never Hike Alone," "Never Hike in the Snow" follows the strange disappearance of Mark Hill, a Crystal Lake resident who went for a hike in the dead of winter and never came home.  As Local Wessex County Sheriff Rick Cologne and Deputy Allen Mabry search for answers, town local Tommy Jarvis believes that his old nemesis Jason Voorhees is to blame. Will Diana Hill ever see her son again, or will her son become another lost victim of the cursed camp?
